title: Rooftop Hot Tub Townhome | Minutes from Broadway
description:
Get ready to live your best life in the Nashville with a stay at Wildflowers and Whiskey! This vibrant 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home is bursting with charm, offering an unforgettable experience for anyone seeking a getaway in the Music City. Every scene is curated for a playful experience, but also cozy enough for you to feel at home.

No locals!
No smoking! 
Guest will be held responsible for any damage during stay.

The space
Property Highlights:

4 Bedrooms, 4 Bathrooms: Plenty of space for families or groups, ensuring everyone has their own cozy retreat after a day of exploring Music City.

* Private Parking: The private garage fits one vehicle

* Rooftop Deck with Hot tub

* Prime Location: Only 10 miles from Broadway, you’re just minutes away from all the action—live music, great food, and the best of Nashville nightlife.

BEDROOM LAYOUT:

1st floor bedroom: Queen over Queen bunk bed and twin over twin bunk bed with ensuite bathroom - sleeps 6

2nd floor bedroom: Queen bed with ensuite bathroom

3rd floor bedroom: Queen bed with en-suite bathroom.

3rd floor Master bedroom:  King size bed with en suite bathroom.

4th floor: Rooftop deck with hot tub
(Our hot tub is serviced every Wednesday morning and the workers will access the rooftop externally)

We do not host locals and will require all of our guests to send a photo of their ID upon booking for insurance reasons. Please keep this in mind when booking. We are legally unable to host anyone under the age of 21.
